## Summary

Describe the operational problem and the bounded change.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Ruff, mypy, and pytest pass
- [ ] Simulator or hardware profile checked as applicable
- [ ] Documentation and changelog updated

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No credentials, site identifiers, addresses, SSIDs, logs, or real captures
- [ ] No new arbitrary command/configuration surface
- [ ] Privileged-action changes received explicit security review
